nom: The INKEY List Ectoin Hydro-Barrier Serum

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily, acne-prone, eczema-affected skin reports the serum works well and is gentle despite oiliness.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin most often report improved hydration, comfort and reduced tightness, though a couple found the texture tacky or felt no dramatic change and one mid-50s dry-skin user found it left her face tight and dry rather than helping.
segments.combination: No combination-skin reviews are present in this set.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive, reactive or eczema/rosacea-prone skin frequently credit the serum with calming burning, redness and barrier damage, though a couple with sensitive skin report new breakouts or whiteheads.
segments.normal: No reviews specifically identify normal skin in this set.
segments.mature: A mid-50s reviewer with fine lines found it left her skin tight and dry rather than firmer, while another describes it as good for her ageing skin overall.

concerns.aging: Two reviewers mention aging skin: one says fine lines are less noticeable and it suits her ageing skin, while a mid-50s user with few fine lines found it made her skin feel tight and dry and did not deliver the firmness she expected.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers repeatedly describe visible relief from dehydration (plumping, glow, bounce, comfort) within days to two weeks, with almost no dissent on this point.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers with reactive, rosacea or eczema-related redness report it calmed and reduced redness within a week or two; no reviewer reports increased redness.
concerns.barrier: Many reviewers describe it as effective at restoring or protecting a damaged skin barrier, including after retinoid or steroid-cream damage, with consistently positive reports and no dissent.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports it helped clear post-blemish dryness and speed healing of blemish-related dry patches; no negative reports on this specific point.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer says breakouts decreased after starting the product, but several others (including one with no acne history) report new whiteheads, pimples or breakouts appearing after use, so opinions clearly diverge.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes it does not leave skin greasy or oily despite being deeply hydrating; no other oiliness-specific complaints appear.

aspects.libelle: Pilling under makeup or other products
Fragrance described as chemical or odd
Pump dispenses too little or is hard to use

extraits.titre: I don't have acne, but this gave me pimples
extraits.texte: I havent had acne in years, but within 2 days of using this my face broke out in several places. Something in the formula has to be clogging pores, beware.

extraits.titre: Like the product, hate the packaging
extraits.texte: I have sensitive skin with eczema & rosacea, & this serum helped heal my skin barrier & seal in hydration. The packaging is awful, it's difficult to get it out of the pump, & the lettering fades quickly, you cant see when you're running low.

As someone with very dry skin, this serum is a true lifesaver. While the HA serum works more on the surfuce, this is a gem that works in the deeper layers of the face as well and helps restore the moisture barrier (don't forget to use ceramide serums and/or moisurisers or lipid moisturisers alongside this if your skin type is dry to completely repair said moisture barrier) while hydrating so much it feels like finding an oasis in the desert. It feels AMAZING and with consistency of use - 2 times a day is the best option - you and others will see effects really quickly. I even got compliments after a week and a half! Since my first bottle I always choose the duo because the price goes down even more and I never want to be without the Ectoin Hydro-Barrier serum, it's almost sorcery in a bottle. This feels like you're taking a shower in your face (feels much better than it sounds) while there's serious nourishment and repair afoot . A must have for dry skin types!

My menopausal skin crisis happened just as this product was launched. My skin was suddenly reacting to products I had used for months/years. It was red, dry, flaky and thick. I took a chance and bought the Ectoin Hydro-Barrier Serum to see if it would help. It did an amazing job of calming my skin. When I finished my first bottle, I decided to use up my old products as I hate waste. Big mistake! Within a few days, everything came back. Needless to say I'm back to the Ectoin and instantly, my skin feels calm. No burn. The photos aren't a direct before and after but show how good this has been for me overall. Amazing stuff!

extraits.titre: Who knew my skin was so dehydrated?
extraits.texte: Dry skin in the winter, extra face washing and sun exposure in the summer. Trentinoin use throughout. My skin has gotten very sensitive with age. At 35 I had the worst acne of my life and I've taken many steps, made many changes and had a lot of patience to get it to a happy and healthy place. Adding this extra hydration before face drying lotions and serums has dramatically helped . My skin tone looks and feels more even and overall comfortable to be in.

I bought this as an "upgrade" to the hyaluronic acid serum which I liked but didn't love. Right from the first use my skin just loves this serum. It goes on smoothly, works well under makeup and hydrates my often dry skin without feeling heavy or greasy. Over time my skin looks brighter and healthier, I guess just generally more balanced/happy. I have sensitive, dry and acne prone skin. The only downside for me is that it doesn't last as long as I'd like!

extraits.titre: Not as good as I had hoped
extraits.texte: Decided to give this a try, as replacement for the hyaluronic acid serum. I had started to notice that my skin was becoming dehydrated, tight and losing firmness. (I am mid 50's and have very few fine lines or wrinkles) I have used this product for approx 14 days, and I have been really disappointed. My face constantly feels tight and dry all day, and this is the only product that I have changed in my skincare routine (I only use Inkey List products). I have a selection of serums, and moisturisers and I like to change between them depending on how my skin is feeling. I won't be finishing this serum, which is disappointing as I had high expectation for this product, and I shall return to the hyaluronic acid serum.
